description:
Convert Markdown (headings, paragraphs, bold, italic, strikethrough, links, images, inline and fenced code, lists and task lists, tables, quotes, rules) to HTML. Raw HTML in the input is escaped, so the output is safe to embed. Use to publish agent-written Markdown on a web page. Example: markdown=# Title
